help: Who gets each of the agency’s notifications, and when the phone rings. A notification about an order goes by itself to the agent who has that order.
hoursText: The seller’s, for each order: his chrono decides

kind.follow: Parcel given to a follow-up agent
kind.sav: After-sales ticket given to an agent

desc.delegatedConfirmation: A seller sends an order to the agency, before it is given to an agent.
desc.order: An order is given to an agent: he has to call it.
desc.due: An order’s chrono turns green: it is time for the next try (Busy, No answer) or for the planned callback (Call back, Postponed).
desc.delivered: An order the agent confirmed is delivered.
desc.returned: The customer refused: the parcel is coming back.
desc.alert: A parcel is on alert or its delivery failed.
desc.delegatedFollow: A seller sends an order’s follow-up to the agency.
desc.follow: A parcel on alert is given to a follow-up agent.
desc.delegatedSav: A seller sends an after-sales ticket to the agency.
desc.sav: An after-sales ticket is given to an agent.
desc.seller: A seller invites the agency, or accepts or declines its request.
desc.payment: A seller marks an invoice paid, or a payment is confirmed.
desc.team: Someone joins, leaves or changes role in the agency.
desc.access: A person’s sellers or products change.

_.confirmation: The one who has the order
_.suivi: The one who follows the parcel
_.sav: The one who has the ticket

order.confirmation: The one it is given to: he calls it
order.agent_manager: A line when orders are given to their team
order.admin: A line when orders are given to the team

due.confirmation: The one who has to call: only his orders
due.agent_manager: A line when an agent of their team has to call
due.admin: A line when an agent has to call

follow.suivi: The one the parcel is given to
follow.agent_manager: A line when parcels are given to their team
follow.admin: A line when parcels are given to the team

delegatedConfirmation.confirmation: Everyone who works for this seller

delegatedFollow.suivi: Everyone who follows this seller’s parcels

sav.sav: The one the ticket is given to

access.confirmation: When their sellers or products change
access.suivi: When their sellers or products change
access.sav: When their sellers or products change

peopleNote: A person chosen by name only gets what concerns them: their orders, their team.
dueNote: The time comes from the seller: his chrono follows his calling hours (Confirmation › Settings › Calls). The agency only chooses who hears it.
phoneWork: The phone rings during the calling hours of the order’s seller. After that, the notification waits in the bell.
pvTeam: The team leaders and the admins

delegatedConfirmation.t: New order sent to your agency for confirmation

delegatedFollow.t: New order sent to your agency for delivery follow-up
delegatedFollow.b: To give to a follow-up agent

delegatedSav.t: New after-sales ticket sent to your agency
delegatedSav.b: To give to an after-sales agent

payment.t: Seller marked an invoice as paid

order.t: Confirmation work assigned in your team

due.t: Orders to call now in your team

follow.t: Delivery follow-up work assigned in your team

kpiDesc.order: The number of orders waiting for a call. An alert when it reaches the threshold.
kpiDesc.follow: The number of parcels on alert not handled yet. An alert when it reaches the threshold.
kpiDesc.sav: The number of after-sales tickets still open. An alert when it reaches the threshold.

thresholdText: An alert when the number reaches this figure: once, then again if it goes down and back up.

kpiRoleDesc.lead: The number for the whole agency

kpiWrong: Set a threshold from 1 to 100,000 and tick at least one person.
